Hi, This is Dr. Ejaz Ali Physiotherapist who loves what he does. 
I and my wife Dr. Sadia have been working in the Healthcare industry for the last 20 years. We have helped several people feel better through simple tips and exercises in their daily routine activities without medication, Injection, or surgery. We support our patients with state-of-the-art equipment and technology to provide their families the compassion and information to establish a real-time recovery. If you are a Medical student and want to learn about Human Anatomy, Physiology, Pathological conditions & their Physiotherapy Management, and other information about the medical field, Here is the best platform for you.. Stay tuned for more videos.
